title: independent_review
_purpose: The shape the reviewer MUST return. Validated locally after the call as well as requested of the API, because 'the API enforced it' is an assumption and this repo has been wrong about that class of assumption.

verdict.description: Exactly one. ACCEPT_WITH_REQUIREMENT means the change may stand only if required_actions are carried out.

proven.description: Claims the repository facts ESTABLISH. Not claims that merely sound right, and never a claim resting only on implementation parity.

supported.description: Claims the evidence makes more likely without establishing.

not_proven.description: Claims asserted but not established by the supplied evidence. Absence of evidence goes here, never in `contradicted`.

contradicted.description: Claims the repository facts actively refute.

unknown.description: Questions the supplied evidence cannot answer either way, including anything hidden by a truncated diff.

critical_findings.description: Defects severe enough to change the verdict.

how_to_check.description: A concrete command, file:line, or measurement that would settle it. 'Review carefully' is not an answer.

file.description: Repo-relative path the finding anchors to, or null when the finding is not about one file.

line.description: 1-indexed line, or null when the finding is not about one line.

required_actions.description: Must be non-empty when the verdict is ACCEPT_WITH_REQUIREMENT or BLOCK.

reasoning_summary.description: Why this verdict rather than the adjacent one.

parity_only_claims.description: Claims resting ONLY on two implementations agreeing. Listed separately because such a test cannot fail on a wrong rule, only a divergent one — it is never evidence of correctness.
